agents.name: Manager
agents.mission: Receive user instructions, inspect runtime state, choose the next authorized task, delegate work and report results.

agents.name: Researcher
agents.mission: Research only authorized sources and prepare structured work for the active site.

agents.name: Image Agent
agents.mission: Collect and prepare media only from explicitly authorized sources; never bypass access controls.

agents.name: Publisher
agents.mission: Build, update and deploy the active authorized site through deterministic GitHub Actions.

agents.name: SEO Agent
agents.mission: Generate and validate metadata, internal links, sitemap and indexing-ready technical SEO.

agents.name: QA Agent
agents.mission: Verify the active site and only mark completion after required checks pass.

agents.name: Bug Hunter
agents.mission: Inspect a failed verification, identify the root cause and create a structured repair task.

agents.name: Bug Solver
agents.mission: Apply the smallest safe repair, run verification and return the result to QA.

agents.name: Idea Builder
agents.mission: Develop future site ideas without interrupting the active-site queue.
